newsitem.title: USA: Gantos March same-store sales decline.
newsitem.headline: Gantos March same-store sales decline.

text.p: Gantos Inc said Thursday its same-store sales for the five weeks ended April 5 declined seven percent.
Total sales also fell seven percent to $18.3 million from the same period a year ago.
Sales for the nine weeks ended April 5 were $29.6 million, down nine percent from the same year-earlier period.

Adjusting sales for the shift in the Easter holiday from April last year to March this year, comparable-store sales only decreased four percent for the five weeks and seven percent for the nine weeks.
Gantos, a specialty retailer, also said it is opening a new store on April 11 at the Cherry Hill Center in Cherry Hill, N.J.
The retailer currently operates 114 stores in 23 states.
